notes: Play together over the internet is easier: open your lake online and get a short room code like K7Q2-M9XT. Friends type it to join. No router settings, and it works behind any home network.

It runs through the new Lantern Lake online server in Europe, which only passes messages between you and your friends and keeps nothing. If it can't be reached, the game falls back to the old router method.
If your connection to the online server drops for a moment, your lake reconnects with the same code and your friends stay in.
